title: Awakening LLMs’ Reasoning Potential: A Fine-Grained Pipeline to Evaluate and Mitigate Vague Perception
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and mitigating 'Vague Perception' (the mismatch between an LLM's potential ability and its inclination to abstain) through a new diagnostic pipeline. The datasets and experiments are centered on logical reasoning and factual understanding (FLD, FOLIO, ScienceQA) rather than religious, moral, or ethical frameworks. It contains only a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section which is excluded by the criteria.
